prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale:ground-only land/coastal/cryosphere imagery;predictable latency,documented quality,retained interfaces. Mission Control Center(Bluebell/local voice):safety,commands,passes,anomalies,routing,handover. Flight Dynamics Facility(Mistral/legacy logs):authoritative accepted-orbit catalog;controlled ephemerides/event predictions→Mission Control Center,Mission Planning System,Payload Processing Facility. Mission Planning System(Cedar):authoritative observation/contact timelines;resource/slew/sun-angle/power/thermal/command/separation checks;command preparation package→Bluebell engineering. Network Control System(Lantern):authoritative circuits/routing/allocations/readiness/contact records;status→Bluebell;accepted-ephemeris pointing;Security Exception Ticket restricts transfer paths until approved containment completes;shall preserve last validated routing,reject unreviewed changes during product transfers. Ground Network Manager(Juniper/rosters):assignments,availability,maintenance,staffing/site coordination;maintenance compatibility mandatory. Antenna Deicing Notice:mandatory pre-acquisition tasks. Spacecraft Operations Team:contingency-margin assessment;early maneuver recommendations;concurrence with Bluebell before authorized-uplink queuing. North S-Band Antenna(nominal),South S-Band Antenna(procedure-compatible alternate):commands/telemetry→Bluebell;Kiruna X-Band Antenna,Svalbard X-Band Antenna:bulk downlink;all qualified tracking. Command Validation Gateway(Osprey):mandatory independent pre-approval syntax/timing/range/sequence/mode/baseline/provenance/configuration/window validation;burn parameters match screened plan. Cybersecurity Desk:access/emergency/transfer exceptions. Telemetry Ingest Service:state→command checks;validated frames/contact/flow/gaps→operations/engineering/processing;Pass Replay Packet;immutable raw staging;session identifier→processors. Orbit Determination Engine:tracking/timing/models/approved maneuvers→solutions;Doppler Residual Report→Flight Dynamics Team:bias/model-error separation before acceptance;refined solution+approved geometry→Laser Retroreflector Window. Flight Dynamics Team:candidate states;threshold-exceeding acquisition/geometry changes→Ephemeris Delta Note. Maneuver screening:fuel,contacts,payload outages. Processing levels record software-build/calibration-baseline/ancillary-input versions for audited regeneration. Payload Calibration Team:approved calibration baseline;trend review before operational eligibility;controlled recent-scene calibration trials compared against operational

New part:
S176: Recovery after suspension prioritizes products with contractual latency commitments, then processes remaining scenes in acquisition order unless mission management approves a different backlog rule.
S177: Long Term Archive is the authoritative repository for Sentinel Vale raw downlink, auxiliary data, processing inputs, generated products, and operational metadata after routine production has completed.
S178: Archive admission begins only after Payload Processing Facility has delivered the product package, associated quality metadata, and checksum evidence required by the configured acceptance rule.
S179: Each accepted object is assigned a persistent identifier that remains stable across media migration, catalogue refresh, and later reprocessing campaigns.
S180: The repository stores object content separately from searchable metadata so that catalogue publication can proceed without exposing internal storage paths.
S181: Catalogue records are published to User Services Portal after Product Quality Service has set the public quality status and the embargo rule has been evaluated.
S182: Products under operational review remain discoverable only to authorized mission staff until the release condition is cleared.
S183: User Services Portal provides search, preview, order, and download functions through a browser interface and documented machine interfaces.
S184: Download services support resumable transfer, integrity verification, and rate controls that protect mission operations from excessive external demand.
S185: Registered users receive authorization scopes based on mission policy, contractual access rights, and applicable data licensing constraints.
S186: Anonymous access is allowed only for product classes that have been approved for open dissemination by mission management.
S187: Long Term Archive retains raw acquisition data for the life of the mission and for the post-mission preservation period defined in the archive policy.
S188: Standard Level 1 and Level 2 products are retained online while demand, contractual latency, or reprocessing dependence justifies low-latency access.
S189: Older product copies may be moved to lower-cost storage when catalogue metadata, checksums, and restore procedures remain available.
S190: Deletion is performed only against superseded temporary products, expired working copies, or objects covered by an approved disposal rule.
S191: Retention exceptions require traceability to the approving authority, the affected product classes, and the expected operational impact.
S192: Reprocessing is triggered when calibration improvements, processor corrections, orbit updates, or quality investigations materially change product fitness for use.
S193: Payload Calibration Team may request a reprocessing campaign when validation evidence shows a systematic radiometric or geometric issue.
S194: Mistral publishes orbit quality state changes to the archive operations queue before catalogue validity flags are updated.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
